title: Independent investigation of taurine–donor interaction energies
difficulty_reasons: The bounded evaluator uses three explicitly submitted Tau–donor pose representatives; exhaustive PM6-D3/MOPAC random-ensemble generation is outside the executable scope.
The agent must validate minima and BSSE/counterpoise-corrected energies and derive an internally consistent pose-level ordering and interpretation.

paper.title: Separation of taurine and Na2SO4 via the in situ formation of deep eutectic solvents: experiments and computational simulation

data.description: Public chemical identity specification for Tau, Im, Gly (glycerol), MEA, charge, multiplicity, 1:2 complex stoichiometry, and the finite pose-subset boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Validated energies, candidate records, protocol, proposed explanations and discriminating evidence, ordering, and limitations.
